1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, wherein said polyalkylenimine molecular weight is __between 500 Da and 1500 Da__.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker, wherein __said multivalent cation crosslinker is present in an amount sufficient to crosslink the polyanion__.

3) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine.

4) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants.

5) (Original) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate.

6) (Original) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprised a nanoparticle with an average particle size of __about 50 to 100 nm__ in diameter.

9) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine and seawater, and __wherein said nanoparticles maintain structural integrity for at least 24 hours at reservoir temperature and pressure conditions__.

10) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of __between 500 Da and 1500 Da__ and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation, wherein __the multivalent cation is complexed within the nanoparticle structure__.

13) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al, wherein __the metal cation is present in a molar ratio of at least 0.5:1 relative to the polyanion__.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer __having anionic functional groups__ that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid.

22) (Original) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is an acrylate-based polymer.

23) (Original) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acrylamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acrylamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, __wherein the polymer has a molecular weight greater than 100,000 Da__.

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where __said__ fluid is brine or seawater, __and wherein the composition is aged at a temperature of at least 40°C for at least 2 hours prior to injection into a reservoir__.
